learning_outcomes.text: Students understand the concept and structure of ERP systems.
They master the modeling of business processes and know typical problems in the introduction of ERP systems.
They possess initial practical knowledge in handling one or more ERP systems.
Students can perform some business processes in an ERP system.

syllabus_topics: Concept and goals of ERP systems
Organizational structures and their mapping in ERP systems
Case studies with one or more ERP systems in several of the following areas: Customer order management, Production, Purchasing, Logistics, Project controlling, Customizing
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by the credit points.
bibliography: Jens Kaufmann, Wilhelm Mülder: Grundkurs Wirtschaftsinformatik, Springer Vieweg
Peter Stahlknecht, Ulrich Hasenkamp, Einführung in die Wirtschaftsinformatik, Springer, Berlin, Heidelberg u.a.
